idea: Online booking and reminder texts for small dental clinics
target_customer: Office managers at dental clinics with one to five chairs

found.text: Clinic staff say missed appointments likely drop after switching to online booking.
Clinics with many no-shows may be the easiest first customers.
Most small clinics still book by phone and lose staff hours to missed appointments.
Most clinics already use online booking software.

unknowns: Whether office managers or dentists choose the booking tool.
How many clinics are locked into contracts with their current software.

riskiest_assumptions.assumption: Missed appointments are a top-three problem for office managers.
riskiest_assumptions.why_risky: The only evidence is a vendor testimonial.
riskiest_assumptions.how_to_test: Ask five office managers to walk through their last no-show.

interview_script.intro: Thanks for talking with me. I'm learning how small clinics handle appointments.

questions.question: Tell me about the last time a patient missed an appointment.
questions.listening_for: What it cost them and what they did afterward.

questions.question: How do you book appointments today?
questions.listening_for: Tools, workarounds, and who does the work.

questions.question: Would you switch to a new booking tool if it cost $50 a month?
What did you try the last time you wanted fewer no-shows?
questions.listening_for: Past spending and effort on the problem.

description.text: Online booking started by two former clinic office managers.
Scheduling and reminder texts for dental groups.

price.text: Not listed publicly. Guess about $50 per month.

market_size.price_covers: The monthly subscription only. There is no one-time fee.

customers.unit: small dental clinics in the US

sam_share.unit: fraction of clinics without a booking tool they like

som_share.unit: fraction of SAM we could win in 3 years
